parameters.name: EnableCrossTenant
parameters.description: Specifies whether to allow transferring ownership to an owner in a different tenant. Default value: false.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The target owner after the transfer. Use the Alibaba Cloud UID.

parameters.name: TableMetaEntityIds
parameters.description: The list of MaxCompute table metadata entity IDs to transfer. A maximum of 100 tables are allowed per request. Duplicate values are not allowed.
